articles.summary_hinglish: abhilekhiya dijaina aura pratishthita ranave nirmana se lekara kal, vastukala aura eka spesasuta prototaipa tak, milana men praidaspheyara italavi lakjari phaishana hausa ke itihasa aura rachanatmaka brahmanda ke madhyama se eka drishya yatra pradana karata hai। aautaluka indiya para sabhi navinatama brekinga nyuja padhaेn aura bharat, manoranjan, shiksha aura duniya bhara ki shirsha kahaniyon se apadeta rahen।
